QUOTE: on_tool_call(json)  // void return, cannot veto ... approved = true ← notify = approve; "**The prompt is notify-only.** `on_tool_call` is `void (*)(const char*, void*)` ... Once it is wired, every call that misses the allow list is approved. The frontend cannot veto"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the callback returns void and approved is set to true unconditionally after firing it, so it cannot refuse.
